mapper.select: select id, action_instance_id as actionInstanceId, step_index as stepIndex, step_name as stepName, step_type as stepType, target, status, attempt_count as attemptCount, payload_json as payloadJson, last_error_code as lastErrorCode, last_error_message as lastErrorMessage, version, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt from action_step_instance where id = #{id}

select id, action_instance_id as actionInstanceId, step_index as stepIndex, step_name as stepName, step_type as stepType, target, status, attempt_count as attemptCount, payload_json as payloadJson, last_error_code as lastErrorCode, last_error_message as lastErrorMessage, version, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt from action_step_instance where action_instance_id = #{actionInstanceId} order by step_index asc
